messages:
alice: Change window now. Promo stuck: cd-deploy failing cache restore (S3 504). Do we pin to last-good or try rerun?
ben: logs show S3 GETs returning 504 consistently, deploybot has backed off. If we wait we risk missing window.
maya: what's the last-good digest? Any DB migrations?
ian: last-good is registry/redwood/api@sha256:ffee1122. No migrations. Safe to pin.
ben: +1 for pin to unblock, but let's kick a quick rerun while we prepare pin PR.
ci-bot: cd-deploy rerun started (id: 76200) restoring cache from s3://redwood-cache/sha256/ffee...
deploybot: Promote blocked: throttle backoff active (5 failures). Manual promote allowed with approvals.
ben: rerun hit 504 again after 40s: `GET https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-cache/ffee -> 504 Gateway Timeout`
ops-bot: infra oncall: investigating elevated 5xx from s3 proxy in us-east-1. ETA unknown.
maya: timebox 10m. If still failing, manual pin. I'll prepare release notes edits in parallel.
ben: opened PR to pin manifest (github.com/redwood/deploy/pull/4980). Patch: `image: registry/redwood/api@sha256:ffee1122` and adds changelog note about manual pin due to cache flake. Requesting review from ian.
ian: reviewing now. manifest-validate run queued.
ci-bot: manifest-validate passed. integration smoke queued against pinned image.
deploybot: manual promote requested by ben for commit ffee1122. Approvals required: ian, alice.
ian: approved. alice: approved.
ben: merging and triggering manual promote. Notifying ops channel.
ops-bot: @infra @support manual promote in change window for release 2026-03-23. Canary will run; watch metrics.
maya: pushed release notes with two UX bullets and Known Issue about CI cache 504s.
alice: thanks all. Follow-up: open RED-1302 to investigate S3 proxy and deploybot backoff tuning.
ian: RED-1302 created and linked to PR/4980.
ci-bot: canary finished green. deploybot: promotion completed, prod updated.
alice: update release checklist and changelog. Closing thread.
